review.reviewBasis: Actual paired GAME/Esri250m ground-plane crop sheets inspected. Coverage review does not establish photographic identity, unknown-height resolution or native drone acceptance.

sheets.finding: All12 northern ring/core residential and office cells inspected. Complete source footprint/road arrangement and measured canopy extent remain; outer-ring trees/hedges, roof/material/storey detail, parking occupancy and source-height estimates visibly differ. Source height/roof inputs are retained rather than inferred from reference imagery. Tall roofs project larger in the perspective ground-plane atlas; acquisition date and photographic parity remain unknown.

All12 downtown-edge, office/campus, residential and elevated highway approach cells inspected. Source footprints, connecting streets and source bridge layouts remain; dense canopy, rooftop equipment/materials, parcel/parking occupancy and unknown vertical levels remain simplified. Roof enlargement and leaning under the perspective250m ground-plane camera are explicit, particularly taller downtown bodies; this view does not independently validate their physical heights or clearance.

All12 northern downtown/highway/pond and central tower cells inspected. Source road, water and body outlines remain; tall roofs show substantial perspective enlargement relative to the250m ground-plane reference and must not be mistaken for measured footprint disagreement. Rooftop/facade detail, source-height unknowns, park/shoreline colour, parking occupancy and landscaping remain limited. Water surface appearance and acquisition date are unmeasured; no bathymetry or photographic parity claim.

All12 central towers/interchange/station, commercial car-lot, mall and residential cells inspected. Original street/source deck and body arrangement retained. Source layer is not a measured metre datum; interchange terrain, supports and clearance, rooftop/facade/material details, parking occupancy and canopy detail remain limited. Tower roof perspective enlargement is explicitly technical-camera projection; no new source dimension is inferred.

All12 central/park/interchange/mall/office/residential cells inspected. OPEN MATERIAL RENDER FINDING: frame57 aerial-r06-c04 shows repeated broad blue pads beyond the Downtown Park curved canal edge; primary original water area102/sourcew1326469169, with adjacentw842753013/w1326469168. Full640GAME and private reference were inspected and sent to root; shared water owner investigates. Preserve exactc78original, no hidden visual pass. Other source roof/storey, terrain/grade, parking, vegetation and tall-roof projection limits remain.

OPEN canal pad finding also appears atframe67/aerial-r07-c04 (southern curved arc); preserve exactc78render and root-owned diagnosis. Source bodies/ways/water remain; narrow park paths/detail, canopy, parking, roof/style/height estimates and shoreline appearance remain limited.
